033/**
034 * Resource-owner password-credentials grant (RFC 6749 &sect;4.3) flow helper.
035 *
036 * <p>
037 * <b>Discouraged.</b>  This grant type was removed from OAuth 2.1 due to long-standing security concerns
038 * (the client sees the user's credentials).  Legitimate use is limited to first-party trusted clients that
039 * already have the user's credentials (e.g. legacy intranet apps mid-migration).  Prefer
040 * {@link OAuthAuthorizationCodeFlow}.
041 *
042 * <p>
043 * Filed under {@link Deprecated &#64;Deprecated(since = "10.0.0")} from day-1 to surface the warning at IDE
044 * compile time to surface the deprecation warning.  Wraps Nimbus's {@link ResourceOwnerPasswordCredentialsGrant}.
045 *
046 * @since 10.0.0
047 * @deprecated Use {@link OAuthAuthorizationCodeFlow} (with PKCE) wherever possible.  The
048 *    resource-owner password-credentials grant was removed from OAuth 2.1.
049 */
050@Deprecated(since = "10.0.0", forRemoval = false)
051@SuppressWarnings({
052   "java:S1192", // Duplicate string literals are OAuth protocol parameter names (e.g. "grant_type", "username"); intentional
053   "java:S1133" // Intentional deprecation retained for backward compatibility until the documented removal; the reminder is not actionable now.
054})
055public class OAuthResourceOwnerFlow {
056
057   /**
058    * Static creator.
059    *
060    * @return A new builder.
061    */
062   @Deprecated(since = "10.0.0", forRemoval = false)
063   public static Builder create() {
064      return new Builder();
065   }
066
067   /**
068    * Builder.
069    */
070   @Deprecated(since = "10.0.0", forRemoval = false)
071   public static class Builder {
072      private URI tokenEndpoint;
073      private String clientId;
074      private Supplier<String> clientSecretSupplier;
075      private String username;
076      private Supplier<String> passwordSupplier;
077      private Set<String> scopes = st();
078      private Consumer<HTTPRequest> httpRequestConfigurator;
079
080      /** Constructor. */
081      @Deprecated(since = "10.0.0", forRemoval = false)
082      protected Builder() {}
083
084      /**
085       * Sets the token endpoint URL.  Required.

088       * @return This object.
089       */
090      @Deprecated(since = "10.0.0", forRemoval = false)
091      public Builder tokenEndpoint(URI value) {
092         tokenEndpoint = assertArgNotNull("value", value);
093         return this;
094      }
095
096      /**

101       */
102      @Deprecated(since = "10.0.0", forRemoval = false)
103      public Builder clientId(String value) {
104         clientId = assertArgNotNullOrBlank("value", value);
105         return this;
106      }
107
108      /**
109       * Sets the OAuth client secret as a literal string.
110       *
111       * @param value The secret.
112       * @return This object.
113       */
114      @Deprecated(since = "10.0.0", forRemoval = false)
115      public Builder clientSecret(String value) {
116         assertArgNotNullOrBlank("value", value);
117         clientSecretSupplier = () -> value;
118         return this;
119      }
120
121      /**
122       * Sets the OAuth client secret via a supplier.
123       *
124       * @param value The supplier.
125       * @return This object.
126       */
127      @Deprecated(since = "10.0.0", forRemoval = false)
128      public Builder clientSecretSupplier(Supplier<String> value) {
129         clientSecretSupplier = assertArgNotNull("value", value);
130         return this;
131      }
132
133      /**
134       * Sets the resource-owner username.  Required.
135       *
136       * @param value The username.
137       * @return This object.
138       */
139      @Deprecated(since = "10.0.0", forRemoval = false)
140      public Builder username(String value) {
141         username = assertArgNotNullOrBlank("value", value);
142         return this;
143      }
144
145      /**
146       * Sets the resource-owner password as a literal string.
147       *
148       * @param value The password.
149       * @return This object.
150       */
151      @Deprecated(since = "10.0.0", forRemoval = false)
152      public Builder password(String value) {
153         assertArgNotNullOrBlank("value", value);
154         passwordSupplier = () -> value;
155         return this;
156      }
157
158      /**
159       * Sets the resource-owner password via a supplier.
160       *
161       * @param value The supplier.
162       * @return This object.
163       */
164      @Deprecated(since = "10.0.0", forRemoval = false)
165      public Builder passwordSupplier(Supplier<String> value) {
166         passwordSupplier = assertArgNotNull("value", value);
167         return this;
168      }
169
170      /**
171       * Adds requested scopes.
172       *
173       * @param values The scopes.
174       * @return This object.
175       */
176      @Deprecated(since = "10.0.0", forRemoval = false)
177      public Builder scope(String... values) {
178         assertArgNotNull("values", values);
179         for (var v : values) {
180            assertArgNotNullOrBlank("scope", v);
181            scopes.add(v);
182         }
183         return this;
184      }

192      @Deprecated(since = "10.0.0", forRemoval = false)
193      public Builder httpRequestConfigurator(Consumer<HTTPRequest> value) {
194         httpRequestConfigurator = assertArgNotNull("value", value);
195         return this;
196      }
197
198      /**
199       * Builds the flow.
200       *
201       * @return A new {@link OAuthResourceOwnerFlow}.
202       */
203      @Deprecated(since = "10.0.0", forRemoval = false)
204      public OAuthResourceOwnerFlow build() {
205         if (tokenEndpoint == null)
206            throw new IllegalStateException("OAuthResourceOwnerFlow requires tokenEndpoint(...)");
207         if (clientId == null)
208            throw new IllegalStateException("OAuthResourceOwnerFlow requires clientId(...)");
209         if (clientSecretSupplier == null)
210            throw new IllegalStateException("OAuthResourceOwnerFlow requires clientSecret(...) or clientSecretSupplier(...)");
211         if (username == null)
212            throw new IllegalStateException("OAuthResourceOwnerFlow requires username(...)");
213         if (passwordSupplier == null)
214            throw new IllegalStateException("OAuthResourceOwnerFlow requires password(...) or passwordSupplier(...)");
215         return new OAuthResourceOwnerFlow(this);
216      }
217   }

219   private final URI tokenEndpoint;
220   private final String clientId;
221   private final Supplier<String> clientSecretSupplier;
222   private final String username;
223   private final Supplier<String> passwordSupplier;
224   private final Set<String> scopes;
225   private final Consumer<HTTPRequest> httpRequestConfigurator;
226
227   /**
228    * Constructor.
229    *
230    * @param b The builder.
231    */
232   @Deprecated(since = "10.0.0", forRemoval = false)
233   protected OAuthResourceOwnerFlow(Builder b) {
234      this.tokenEndpoint = b.tokenEndpoint;
235      this.clientId = b.clientId;
236      this.clientSecretSupplier = b.clientSecretSupplier;
237      this.username = b.username;
238      this.passwordSupplier = b.passwordSupplier;
239      this.scopes = u(cp(b.scopes));
240      this.httpRequestConfigurator = b.httpRequestConfigurator;
241   }
242
243   /**
244    * Acquires a token from the IdP.
245    *
246    * @return The acquired token.
247    */
248   @Deprecated(since = "10.0.0", forRemoval = false)
249   public OAuthToken acquire() {
250      var clientAuth = new ClientSecretBasic(new ClientID(clientId), new Secret(clientSecretSupplier.get()));
251      var grant = new ResourceOwnerPasswordCredentialsGrant(username, new Secret(passwordSupplier.get()));
252      Scope nimbusScope = scopes.isEmpty() ? null : new Scope(scopes.toArray(new String[0]));
253      var req = new TokenRequest.Builder(tokenEndpoint, clientAuth, grant)
254         .scope(nimbusScope)
255         .build();
256      return Flows.send(req, null, httpRequestConfigurator);
257   }
258}
